description: Two layers with light of their own on a near-black bed. Top left: a cyan arrow with a `glow` in its own colours, radius 0.04 of the frame's height at intensity 3 -- a soft cyan halo hugging the shaft and the head, brightest against the line and fading to the bed about three radii out. Bottom right: a pale yellow `database` icon with an orange-tinted glow -- an orange halo round the drum, with the icon's own strokes still pale yellow on top of it. What a wrong render looks like: no halo at all means the glow never reached the compositor; a halo that is the arrow's own shape, hard-edged and offset, means the shadow path ran instead; a halo with a straight, square cut-off edge means the picture was not padded out to the halo's reach; the icon's strokes turning orange means the glow was drawn over the layer rather than under it; a dark ring between the strokes and the halo means the blur averaged straight rather than premultiplied alpha.
